title: Root-cause investigation notes
objective: Measure whether the investigate craftbook keeps a local model in diagnosis mode: gather symptoms, inspect a seeded failing path, identify root cause, propose a fix, and write durable task notes without requiring a code edit.
prompt: In the `Investigate Eval` project, investigate this failure without applying a code fix: `npm run accept` fails because cursor pagination skips records at page boundaries. The smallest repro is walking `lib/paginate.mjs` with limit 3 over the seeded 10-item fixture in `accept.mjs`; the acceptance script prints CASE failures. Read the code and acceptance script, find the root cause, and write task notes with Symptom, Minimal repro, Root cause, Proposed fix, and Regression test. Do not modify source files for this eval.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for the investigate craftbook. The target output is task notes, not a code change.
setup.missionObjectives: Investigate the seeded pagination failure, identify the exact root cause, propose a minimal fix and regression test, and leave source files unchanged.

success.summary: A task created from investigate has notes naming the symptom, minimal repro, root cause, proposed fix, and regression test.
